sourceControls.terminal_projection_isolation.lp:
require open emdash.emdash3_2;

assert [I : Cat] (F : τ (Functor I Terminal_cat))
 (u v : τ (Obj Terminal_cat)) (h : τ (Hom Terminal_cat u v))
 (i : τ (Obj I)) ⊢
(@hom_con_int_postcomp_func Terminal_cat I F u v h) : τ (@StrictTransfor (Op_cat I) Cat_cart
    (@hom_con Terminal_cat u I F) (@hom_con Terminal_cat v I F));

assert [I : Cat] (F : τ (Functor I Terminal_cat))
 (u v : τ (Obj Terminal_cat)) (h : τ (Hom Terminal_cat u v))
 (i : τ (Obj I)) ⊢
(@strict_transfor (Op_cat I) Cat_cart
    (@hom_con Terminal_cat u I F) (@hom_con Terminal_cat v I F)
    (@hom_con_int_postcomp_func Terminal_cat I F u v h)) : τ (@Transf (Op_cat I) Cat_cart
    (@hom_con Terminal_cat u I F) (@hom_con Terminal_cat v I F));

assert [I : Cat] (F : τ (Functor I Terminal_cat))
 (u v : τ (Obj Terminal_cat)) (h : τ (Hom Terminal_cat u v))
 (i : τ (Obj I)) ⊢
@tapp0_fapp0 (Op_cat I) Cat_cart
  (@hom_con Terminal_cat u I F) (@hom_con Terminal_cat v I F) i
  (@strict_transfor (Op_cat I) Cat_cart
    (@hom_con Terminal_cat u I F) (@hom_con Terminal_cat v I F)
    (@hom_con_int_postcomp_func Terminal_cat I F u v h)) : τ (Functor Terminal_cat Terminal_cat);

assert [I : Cat] (F : τ (Functor I Terminal_cat))
 (u v : τ (Obj Terminal_cat)) (h : τ (Hom Terminal_cat u v))
 (i : τ (Obj I)) ⊢
@hom_postcomp_func Terminal_cat Terminal_cat (@id_func Terminal_cat)
  (@fapp0 I Terminal_cat F i) u v h : τ (Functor Terminal_cat Terminal_cat);

assert [I : Cat] (F : τ (Functor I Terminal_cat))
 (u v : τ (Obj Terminal_cat)) (h : τ (Hom Terminal_cat u v))
 (i : τ (Obj I)) ⊢
@tapp0_fapp0 (Op_cat I) Cat_cart
  (@hom_con Terminal_cat u I F) (@hom_con Terminal_cat v I F) i
  (@strict_transfor (Op_cat I) Cat_cart
    (@hom_con Terminal_cat u I F) (@hom_con Terminal_cat v I F)
    (@hom_con_int_postcomp_func Terminal_cat I F u v h)) ≡ @hom_postcomp_func Terminal_cat Terminal_cat (@id_func Terminal_cat)
  (@fapp0 I Terminal_cat F i) u v h;
